messages:
maya: Quick standup note: customers keep asking for a clearer onboarding path for long-term audit retention + BYOK. Need to agree minimal launch criteria and what stays in pilot.

sam: Agree. Customers want three things: searchable logs, an easy export flow, and explicit contract language about retention costs. BYOK is secondary for most.

linh: Suggest we scope MVP narrowly: 90d default, 1y paid tier, 5y pilot. Deliverables: schema + search, manifest-based exports, admin toggle for tenant retention.

priya: Product priority: core SOC2 customers first. BYOK pilot should be optional and clearly labeled as "pilot - no HSM attestation". We'll only mark HSM-attested BYOK as GA later.

samira: Security constraints: audit log writes must be append-only in storage and include signer metadata. For any BYOK flow we require key provenance docs and rotation policy. For HSM attestation, we need vendor attestation AND our internal checklist.

alejandro: Legal asks: a one-page export contract appendix and a minimal signed legal-hold template. Also flag any retention >5y for mandatory risk review.

maya: Ops: what SLAs can we realistically promise for evidence requests? Customers expect fast turnarounds.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Suggested SLA matrix uploaded to ops drive (ref: /compliance/exports/sla-matrix). Rough defaults: 48h for manifest/index, 5 business days for quoted bulk exports under 2TB.

linh: Technical notes: resumeable exports + chunked manifests are feasible. We should surface an estimated cost in the manifest and require customer ack for >500GB exports.

samira: Security: implement signed manifests + optional Merkle root per export to provide tamper proofing. Signing every chunk is expensive; recommend signing batch commits + a final export root.

sam: UX: console flow should show estimated monthly cost for the selected retention tier, BYOK toggle with pilot warning, and export ETA ranges. Add an "accept costs" checkbox on large exports.

priya: Prioritization suggestion: commit to logs+export+evidence-pack generator as v1. BYOK pilot + 5y tier as v1.1 gated by paying pilot customers. HSM BYOK as v2.

maya: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- Index + search for audit logs validated with sample workloads.
- Export manifest + resumeable transfer tested end-to-end for <=500GB dataset.
- Evidence-pack generator produces SOC2-ready artifact and signed manifest.
- Tenant retention toggle visible in console with billing estimate.
- Legal has draft appendix and minimal legal-hold template.
- Security provides BYOK pilot checklist and Merkle proof spec.

alejandro: I'll draft the appendix and the legal-hold template and post for comments. Add a clause: any customer-requested retention >5y triggers a legal risk review.

samira: I'll produce the BYOK pilot checklist: required key ARN, rotation cadence, incident contact, and a note that pilot keys are not HSM-attested. Also a short spec for Merkle root posting to internal attestation service.

linh: Engineering asks: need a 2-week spike to measure manifest generation time and Merkle compute cost. Who can take it?

sam: Eng-runtime can take a 10-day spike to prototype manifest -> chunked upload -> resume -> final signed manifest. We'll surface perf numbers.

ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder: anyone creating export guarantees must add an export-runbook and an owner. Ops volunteers to be runbook steward for initial pilot.

priya: We'll prepare a pilot customer list (2-4) that represent SOC2-first and a regulated-but-flexible profile. We'll only enable BYOK pilot for customers agreeing to pilot terms.

maya: Action list recap:
- sam: run spike prototype for export flow (10d).
- samira: BYOK pilot checklist + Merkle spec (3d).
- alejandro: legal appendix + hold template (3d).
- linh: integration test plan for resumeable exports (5d).
- ops-bot: draft export-runbook + SLI definitions (3d).
- priya: pilot customer shortlist + communications (2d).

maya: I'll consolidate into a roadmap block and drop into the compliance drive. Please add edge cases (gov cloud, EU e-discovery, procurement clauses) inline to the doc. :spiral_notepad:
